candidates: In `manager-api` event handlers that call `getEventMetadata` to determine ref-locality (i.e., `const { ref } = getEventMetadata(...)`), verify that every side-effect call — such as `api.updateGlobals` or any channel emission that pushes state to the preview — is also gated by `!ref`. Code placed after the `if (!ref) / else` block runs for all refs unconditionally; failing to add the `!ref` guard there allows non-local events (e.g. a `SET_GLOBALS` from a ref) to silently trigger global-state updates and violates the 'ignore non-local refs' contract.
